description: Narrowed to the context half of the original ticket; the Defk.Errors split is defk-vlf. Decisions (/improve-codebase-architecture grilling 2026-10-12): mechanism is one pdict key :defk_ctx holding a single struct (not full explicit threading - that would churn most of the compiler's 347 function signatures and collide with every queued compiler ticket; threading can follow cluster-by-cluster). Struct shape: compile-wide fields (file, module, lines, fun, diags, report, ...) plus a lowering sub-struct replaced wholesale per kernel - lower_kernel's 15-key reset becomes 'put a fresh sub-struct', probe and with_acc_facts backtracking become get/put of one value, and the lowering_key?/1 name-prefix predicate dies. Defk.Copies' struct (defk-z8y) becomes one field of lowering. ElixirMode's shared :defk_file read becomes an explicit argument; the runtime mode key in with_mode is runtime dispatch, out of scope. First slice, landable alone: compile/4 returns {c_src, sigs, report}, killing report/0 and :defk_report (lib/defk.ex 387-390). Tests gained: lowering fragments initialise one key; a failed probe provably changes nothing; per-compile report assertions. Sequenced after defk-k4x and defk-z8y absorb their keys, in a quiet compiler-queue window per triage.

comments.text: Review 2026-10-09, supporting evidence: every new construct must be added in three places that have to agree (C emitter in compiler.ex, Elixir-mode emitter in elixir_mode.ex, registry in errors.ex), and the runtime messages are hand-copied between defk_runtime.h and ElixirMode.Ops. The agreement properties (defk-ne6) are what keep the two emitters honest until this refactor; consider sequencing it after them so the refactor has a safety net.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Triage (2026-10-11): ready-for-human. A structural decision (split Defk.Errors into registry/rendering vs language facts, a compile context struct instead of process-dictionary globals, atom or compile-time-checked codes) that rewrites code nearly every queued compiler ticket touches. Start it when the compiler queue is quiet, with the maintainer, e.g. via /improve-codebase-architecture. The agreement properties (defk-ne6) it wanted as a safety net have landed.

Split per the 2026-10-12 architecture review: this ticket keeps the context work (decisions now in the description); the Defk.Errors split moved to defk-vlf with its own decisions (three-way cut, codes stay strings with compile-time-checked err!). The runtime-message hand-copy finding moved to defk-0ha step 2 (single-sourced messages); the three-places-per-construct finding is addressed from the other side by defk-o49 (builtin signature table, ADR-0008). Full ordering: defk-mif (dump-all-C) -> defk-k4x (Facts) -> defk-ch4 (strips) / ADR-0007 migration; defk-z8y (Copies) parallel; then this ticket; defk-vlf, defk-k95, defk-0ha, defk-o49 independent.

title: Compiler context: one :defk_ctx struct instead of process-dictionary globals
